correctness.rationale: Each partial involution squares to a domain partial identity. Pairwise commutation forces invariance of all domain-membership blocks. Restricted active maps on each block are exactly an action of an elementary abelian 2-group, and conversely these actions define one tuple. Transitive orbit types are indexed by codimension-r subgroups (Gaussian binomial coefficient); their labelled exponential contributions are u^(2^r)/2^r, since the orbit automorphism group has size 2^r. Rank weights are correct because the product domain is exactly the all-active block. Differentiating the exact t=2 EGF supplies the recurrence. A standalone independent direct-map checker exhaustively matched every joint domain/product-rank stratum for (t,n)=(1,5),(2,0..6),(3,0..4),(4,2),(4,3). The finite tests are corroborative, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This computes a natural, complete semigroup invariant: the ordered commuting-tuple and joint domain/product-rank spectra of all self-inverse elements of the symmetric inverse monoid, in every labelled set size and arity. The support-block/elementary-abelian action classification explains the nontrivial degree-four orbit contribution and gives a reusable multivariate enumerator; it is neither a fixed small-count census nor a mere reparametrized full-involution count. The explicit product-rank marker supplies data needed to study induced commuting graphs and distributions of intersections.
